s.how: Cut 1kg watermelon into thick wedges. Top with 150g crumbled feta, torn mint and a squeeze of lime, then a pinch of flaky salt. Serve ice cold. Carry it in with both arms.

s.n: Staff cabin onion dip and pretzels
s.note: the after-hours dance party in the staff cabins
s.how: Slice 2 brown onions thinly and cook in 30g butter over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy. Cool and chop finely. Beat 250g sour cream with 100g cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce and salt, then fold in the onions and chopped chives. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with 200g pretzels and a 170g bag of potato chips.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket. Lay on 3 sliced onions in a roasting dish with 500ml stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tsp sweet paprika. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

w.note: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
w.how: Blitz 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 100g sugar dissolved in 100ml hot water. Strain, pour into a tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes. Scoop into cups.

d.note: the end of summer show at Kellerman's
d.how: Grate a 3cm piece of ginger into a punch bowl with the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp caster sugar and stir to dissolve. Add 1L pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and chill for 1 hour. Just before serving add 1L cold ginger ale, a tray of ice, 1 sliced orange, a handful of pineapple chunks and torn mint.
